item.title: The Query Letter that Got Me an Agent
item.description: I never expected to be complimented on how I write about bugs. Insects. The bane of my existence, one of my top (ten?) fears. But here we are. Apparently, all it took for me to get an offer of representation was to stare deeply into the eyes of insects in maximum-zoom, unholy close-up photos so I could realistically write about their scuttling appendages and chitinous segments for 8 hours a day, 5 days a week, 7 weeks straight.
